4.6 Anonymous Hazard Reporting
• To report a hazard or share a health and safety concern, employees may call (650) 723-0448 or
submit a concern via EH&S’s web address – www.ehs.stanford.edu
• Hazard reporting may be done anonymously or confidentially.
4.7 Anti-Reprisal Policy
• Employees and students not be discharged or discriminated against in any manner for
shall
bona fide reporting of health and safety hazards to Stanford or to appropriate governmental
agencies. Supervisors inform employees and students of this policy and encourage
shall
reporting of workplace hazards to the management.
5.0 VIOLENCE IN THE WORKPLACE POLICY
Stanford University has developed a policy which provides guidelines for responding to violence or threats of
violence in the workplace - see Administrative Policy 2.2.4 entitled, “Violence in the Workplace”, which is
available at - https://adminguide.stanford.edu/chapter-2/subchapter-2/policy-2-2-4.
The general roles and responsibilities of employees, supervisors, Staff Affairs Officers, Employee Relations,
Help Center, and Police/Security are dictated by the type of situation. There are specific procedures for
responding to:
• Threats of violence.
• Acts of violence not involving injuries or weapons.
• Acts of violence involving injuries or weapons.
